## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change belongs in seeded-maze.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm verify`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has an observable regression test
- [ ] Public API or behavior changes are reflected in README/API docs
- [ ] A change to what a seed produces is called out as breaking (a `!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer)

## Compatibility

List behavior changes, migration needs, or write “No compatibility impact.”
